contributions.basis: cover-line1 (all three cells are zero glyphs) and Form A's printed TOTAL (also a zero glyph)
contributions.detail: Form A carries EXACTLY ONE inked row -- 8/15/20, 'Independant American Party', In Kind? = 'Yes' -- and its amount cell holds a BARE DASH. Per the repo zero-glyph ruling a bare dash is BLANK, not zero, so the row has no value to sum and no itemized figure can be claimed. The printed schedule TOTAL and all three cover line-1 cells are slashed-zero glyphs (= 0). Whether the filer valued this in-kind gift at zero or simply never valued it cannot be determined from the page, so the side's reconciliation is honestly 'unknown' rather than a manufactured 0 = 0. NOTE the $3.00 on cover line 2 is the sub-$50 AGGREGATE (LAST 3.00, THIS zero glyph, CUM 3.00) and is never itemized -- it must not be compared against Form A. First report shown in the cycle for line 1 (all LAST cells zero), so scope recorded cumulative.

expenditures.basis: cover-line3 (all zero glyphs) and Form B's printed TOTAL (zero glyph)
expenditures.detail: Form B carries EXACTLY ONE inked row, the mirror of the Form A row: 8/15/20, 'Independant American Party', purpose 'campaign signs 200 count', and in the AMOUNT column the filer wrote the WORDS 'In-Kind donation' instead of a figure. That is not a numeral, so the amount is blank and the side cannot be summed. Printed TOTAL and all cover line-3 cells are zero glyphs.

gates.page_subtotal: p2: printed TOTAL is a zero glyph; the single row's amount is a bare dash (blank) -- nothing to sum, so the gate cannot be run either way. p3: identical (printed TOTAL a zero glyph, the single amount cell holds words). Both figures named; no value invented.
gates.row_count: p2 rowbands.py geometry_status=gaps, 33 bands over the ~35-line ruled grid; exactly ONE inked row, emitted as one row -- its contributor name WRAPS onto the next ruled line ('Party'), which is a continuation of row 1 and NOT a second row (the amount and In Kind? cells of that band are empty). p3 identical: 33 bands, one inked row whose payee name wraps onto the following line.
gates.geometry_proof: p2 600dpi crop of the row-1 band renders '8/15/20 | Independant American | $ - | Yes'; the control crop one row-pitch below renders only the wrapped word 'Party' with EMPTY amount and In Kind? cells, confirming the row index is not shifted. p3 row-1 crop renders '8/15/20 | Independant American | campaign signs 200 count | $ In-Kind donation'.
gates.balance_chain: 0 (over-$50) + 3.00 (sub-$50 aggregate, cumulative) - 0 (expenses) = 3.00, exactly the printed line-4 CUMULATIVE balance -- closes. The cover's THIS-REPORT balance cell is left blank by the filer. No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk, so no cross-filing cumulative chain could be run.

IN-KIND WITHOUT A VALUE: the single transaction is one in-kind gift of campaign signs from the Independant American Party (the filer's own spelling), recorded on BOTH schedules with no dollar figure anywhere -- Form A's amount is a bare dash, Form B's amount cell holds the words 'In-Kind donation'. Both rows are published with blank amounts and needs_review. Candidate street address and home phone discarded at read time.
